questions.prompt: Using the Claude formula (28×28-pixel patches), about how many tokens is a 1000×1000 image?

options.explanation: Tokens come from 28×28 patches, not single pixels.
Images are converted to tokens and billed as input.

questions.prompt: How do both vendors feed a PDF page to a vision model?

options.text: As extracted text plus an image of the page.
options.explanation: Right. Claude and OpenAI both send the page text and a page image.

options.text: As text only, with no page images.
options.explanation: Both also send an image of each page, so charts and layout are visible.

options.text: As one single image for the whole file and no text.
options.explanation: Each page becomes its own image, plus its text.

questions.prompt: Is audio input the same on every vendor?

options.text: No. It differs by vendor, so check each vendor's docs before you design a voice feature.
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI documents several audio inputs; the Claude docs document image and PDF input, and the Claude models and features overviews do not list audio input.

options.text: Yes. Every model takes audio like text, so you can design the feature before choosing a vendor.
